analysis: Retain every trial. Matched power-integral/counter differences at common counter-query endpoints. Report absolute J, W, J/frame, individual pairs, block spread and all flags. No assumed ground truth
copy_control: Retains state uploads, CUDA event calls, output and previous-state device copies; not a pure memcpy-only kernel
counter_windows: All modes read cumulative counter immediately before and after the window; only power_counter polls it inside the window
idle_control: Context and allocations resident. No CUDA launches, copies, events or synchronization during the no_launch warmup/measurement; 60-Hz host cadence and common watchdog remain
inference_unit: Session/seed block, not individual frame or shared-baseline contrast. Sessions are one sitting, not independent days or devices
limitations: No external meter; no formal statistical power calculation; four within-sitting blocks cannot establish general energy equivalence or physical accuracy
order: Random block order; four-period Williams ordering balances main policy position and first-order predecessors across four sessions. Fresh scenario seeds each session
polling: Start-to-start randomized U(0.8,1.2) times nominal interval; no catch-up bursts; achieved intervals logged
power_fields: 185 average and 186 instantaneous requested only in dedicated fields_on trials; raw API and per-field status retained; never substituted into the primary estimator
runtime_note: Allow about 75-95 minutes for full run, including setup, correctness, file writing and slower hardware; this is an estimate, not a timeout
software_changes: No driver/clock/power-limit/persistent power-plan changes. Temporary idle-sleep prevention and classic-console QuickEdit disable restored on exit
stopping: Fixed plan; no stopping for desired results. Stop on API/correctness failure, AC loss, temperature >=85 C, watchdog gap >5 s, clock discontinuity >2 s, unbracketed primary power or window overrun >2 s
sustained_control: Uncapped static full rendering, fixed elapsed duration. Diagnostic only, excluded from 60-Hz policy savings; P8 departure is not guaranteed
